description: Run desktop-core calls on a 64 MB stack in apps/openagents-desktop/DesktopCore.swift to prevent stack-overflow crash on open.

steps.send: OpenAgents Desktop crashes on open with a stack overflow because Coax desktop-core calls exceed the default macOS main/worker thread stack (#13794). In `apps/openagents-desktop/DesktopCore.swift`, add `onCoreStack<R>(_ body: () -> R) -> R` that executes `body` on a dedicated `Thread` with a 64 MB `stackSize` (re-entering directly if already on the core stack), and route `DesktopCore` / `Worktree.swift` calls through it. Verify syntax with `swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/DesktopCore.swift apps/openagents-desktop/Worktree.swift apps/openagents-desktop/worktree-test.swift`.

graders.run: swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/DesktopCore.swift apps/openagents-desktop/Worktree.swift apps/openagents-desktop/worktree-test.swift && grep -q 'onCoreStack' apps/openagents-desktop/DesktopCore.swift && grep -q 'stackSize' apps/openagents-desktop/DesktopCore.swift
